meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Viewnear collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

hero.title: Privacy <hl>Policy</hl>
hero.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

intro: Viewnear (“Viewnear”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you use our website and services, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using our website you agree to the practices described here.

collect.heading: Information we collect
collect.intro: We collect information in the following ways:

items.label: Information you give us.
items.body: When you contact us, request a conversation with our team, subscribe to updates, apply for a role, or fill in a form, we collect details such as your name, email address, company, and the contents of your message.

items.label: Information collected automatically.
items.body: When you visit our site we may automatically collect technical data such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages viewed, and referring URLs.

items.label: Information from third parties.
items.body: We may receive limited information from analytics providers and professional networks where you have engaged with us.

use.heading: How we use your information
use.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Respond to your inquiries and provide the services you request;
Operate, maintain, and improve our website and services;
Send you updates, content, or marketing where you have opted in;
Comply with legal obligations and protect against misuse.

legalBasis.heading: Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.body: Where applicable law requires it, we process personal data on the basis of your consent, the performance of a contract, our legitimate business interests, or compliance with a legal obligation.

cookies.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to make the site work, to remember your preferences, and to understand how the site is used. Essential cookies are required for the site to function; analytics cookies help us improve it. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings, though some features may not work as intended if you do. You can also change or withdraw your consent at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer.

sharing.heading: Sharing your information
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with trusted service providers who help us operate our website and deliver our services (for example hosting and analytics providers), all of whom are bound to protect it. We may also disclose information where required by law or to protect our rights.

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.body: We keep personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required to meet legal, accounting, or reporting obligations.

international.heading: International transfers
international.body: Viewnear serves clients across the Americas. Your information may be processed in countries other than your own. Where it is, we take steps to ensure it remains protected in line with this policy and applicable law.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, and to object to certain processing or withdraw consent. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against loss, misuse, and unauthorized access. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, however, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

children.heading: Children's privacy
children.body: Our website and services are not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the “Last updated” date above. Material changes will be highlighted on this page.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this policy or how we handle your information, contact us at <link>contact@viewnear.com</link>.
